OBF really had a terrible take about Russia, so much that I wonder if he's incentivized to skew reality.

Russia's real strength is one that no politician or western media every says out loud and it's not their nuclear arsenal: 

Russia is completely self sufficient and can exist as a microcosm. It participates in global trade and international relations, but it doesn't need to in order to survive. Russia's industries production like energy, military, scientific, medical are fully in house; everything from mineral extraction, synthesis, design to final product is all sourced within. It has the self sufficiency to do so and importantly has the scientific community, medical community, logistics and production industry to disconnect from the global market when the global market if or when it happened, or in times of great struggle. Again, it is a global international trading partner, but it doesn't need to be. That is the precise reason it is fine as it's 99% shut off from the western markets, yet the west needs Russian production.

Pay: Russia has money and can survive in it's own world if needed, yes international trade is a luxury, but not necessary for Russian existence (interesting to note as well, by Purchasing power parity, Russia's GDP surpassed Germany and Japan making it the 4th largest economy after the China, US and India). 

Defend: now this claim of OBF is terrible, it shows he knows nothing about Russian military goods production. As I've said before, Russia sources all of its own materials and parts. 

Decide: Claiming Russia can't make a decision without Beijing is nonsense. Russia and China work extremely close together in all things, but it's a two way partnership which benefits both parties vastly -- it actually makes them a pair that can rival the US western lead world, which is why the western world is in the panic that it is in. Likely a worse dependence is the EU on the US. Europe cannot Pay, Defend or Decide ANYTHING without the US. Nothing at all. The EU is a participant in global super powers, it is not a player.
